name: log
algorithm: Write n log lines "INFO event <k> took <(k*7) mod 1000> us" through each language's standard logger (or formatted write) into one in-memory buffer, emptied before each rep, reps times (README.md).

skip.rust: no std logger: Rust std has none (the log crate is not std); no crate stands in
skip.mk-wrap: the checksum already uses the wrapping operators; the logger has no arithmetic to wrap

no_counts: B24 does not apply: an idiomatic row compares libraries; the checksum (the output's length summed over reps) checks that every column wrote the same text
notes: Idiomatic standard library (plan/06-m6.md 4.1): Mk std.log Logger.New over a Text's Writer, Info with a two-hole format (interim run-time walk until R-L1, status/std-cli.md); Go log.New(&bytes.Buffer, "INFO ", 0) and Printf; C snprintf after a memcpy of the level word into a doubling buffer; Zig std.log.info through a custom std_options.logFn into one std.Io.Writer.Allocating (the comptime format, as std.log's). Lines per second = n x reps / median. Checksums from a Go reference of the pseudo-code (std-cli session 1); verify through tools/bench before timing.
